title: Document deployment, pairing, rollback, and Step 4 boundary
acceptance_criteria: Documentation lists D1 creation/migration, Worker deployment, secret setup, VAPID public-key configuration, allowed origins, pairing, device reset, and subscription removal without containing real secret values.
Deployment instructions include local/test validation and explicitly keep the Pages frontend separate from the Worker API.
Documentation states that exercises, routines, and generated workout data remain local and that Step 4 scheduled push delivery is not implemented by this feature.
The final web tests, lint, build, Worker tests, and configuration validation commands are recorded and pass before completion.
completion_summary: Documented separate Pages/Worker deployment, D1 migration, origins, encrypted secrets, pairing, reset/revoke, validation, and Step 4 boundary.
